subject: br-codigo-penal
note: P2 sweep B: Parte Especial Títulos I–V, arts. 121–212 (crimes against the person, property, immaterial property, the organisation of labour, religious sentiment and respect for the dead), and Vide markers V18–V30. Every source quoted here was retrieved on 2026-09-29 and every quote is copied from the retrieved text. The STF's own sites (portal.stf.jus.br, jurisprudencia.stf.jus.br, noticias.stf.jus.br, redir.stf.jus.br) returned HTTP 403 to curl, to WebFetch and to a real Chrome session. So no STF text here is quoted from the STF itself. STF súmulas are quoted from LexML (Senado Federal), which indexes them by URN. STF acórdão ementas and repercussão-geral theses are quoted as reproduced on the official sites of other courts (TJDFT, TST), which name the STF decision they quote. The status of pending STF cases is taken from dated press reports, and each such entry says so. STJ súmulas are quoted from the STJ's own scon pages. Statutes are quoted from Planalto. Result in one line: every 2025–2026 amendment to arts. 121–212 is in force today (no vacatio legis), but two presidential vetoes on art. 157 are still awaiting deliberation in Congress. ADPF 54 reads down arts. 124, 126 and 128. Lei 7.209/1984 art. 2 removes the réis fine amounts from arts. 129 § 5, 153 and 154. Twenty-four reserved forks are described in sweep-b.forks-proposed.json. Revised the same day, after the conductor's relays, to add three entries (M-sweep-b-45, -46 and -47) and two forks (F-sweep-b-23 and -24): STF Tema 1053 on art. 182 I, and the dangling reference in art. 147-A § 1º II.

searches.question: Which later norms does the Senado's metadata record as touching a dispositivo of arts. 121–212? Which of them were signed in 2025 or 2026? Does the Senado record any STF 'interpretação conforme' or any vetoed amendment in this range?
searches.scope: SOURCE/senado-dadosabertos-527942.xml (Senado Dados Abertos, legislacao/527942, Versao 29/09/2026 07:28:51), flattened to one row per <item>. Kept: rows whose dispositivo names an article numbered 121–212, which gives 260 rows from 78 norms.
searches.query: perl extraction of <vide>/<itens>/<item> rows; filter Art. 121–212; group by datAssinatura year and by item comentario
searches.coverage_note: The metadata is only as complete as the Senado's indexing. It lists 12 norms signed in 2025–2026 that touch this range: Leis 15.123, 15.134, 15.159, 15.163, 15.181 and 15.229 of 2025; LC 225/2026; and Leis 15.358, 15.384, 15.397, 15.455 and 15.517 of 2026. Their vigência is checked in S-sweep-b-02. There are no 'Declaração de Interpretação conforme a Constituição' rows for arts. 121–212, because the Senado indexes only 7 STF rulings for the whole Code and all of them fall in arts. 23–91. So the absence of STF rows here says nothing about STF case law; S-sweep-b-05, -06 and -08 cover that. The index also records two 'Alteração/Acréscimo Vetado' rows on art. 157 (Lei 15.397/2026 on § 3º I; Lei 15.517/2026 on § 2º-A III e). These led to S-sweep-b-03. The 34 'Dispositivo Correlato' rows point at related statutes: Leis 1.521/1951, 4.611/1965, 4.737/1965, 4.898/1965, 5.250/1967, 5.988/1973, 7.357/1985, 7.960/1989 and others. These were not individually swept, except where a Vide marker or a finding below cites them. Bills pending in Congress (PL/PLS) are not in this index and were not searched.

searches.question: Is every amendment signed in 2025 or 2026 that touches arts. 121–212 in force on 2026-09-29, or does any of them carry a vacatio legis?
searches.scope: Planalto's text of each of the 12 norms from S-sweep-b-01, read at its vigência clause and its DOU line. Lei 15.123/2025 art. 3º and 15.134/2025 art. 11 (DOU 25.4.2025 and 7.5.2025). Lei 15.159/2025 art. 4º and 15.163/2025 art. 6º (DOU 4.7.2025). Lei 15.181/2025 art. 6º (DOU 29.7.2025). Lei 15.229/2025 art. 2º (DOU 3.10.2025). LC 225/2026 art. 58 (DOU 9.1.2026). Lei 15.358/2026 art. 44 (DOU 25.3.2026). Lei 15.384/2026 art. 5º (DOU 10.4.2026). Lei 15.397/2026 art. 4º (DOU 4.5.2026). Lei 15.455/2026 art. 10 (DOU 2.7.2026). Lei 15.517/2026 art. 4º (DOU 23.9.2026). All at https://www.planalto.gov.br/ccivil_03/_ato2023-2026/<year>/lei/L<n>.htm; LC 225 at https://www.planalto.gov.br/ccivil_03/leis/lcp/Lcp225.htm.
searches.query: grep 'entra em vigor' in each fetched text
searches.coverage_note: Every one of the 11 ordinary laws says 'Esta Lei entra em vigor na data de sua publicação'. LC 225/2026 art. 58 defers only its Confia/Sintonia programmes (arts. 19–32 and 40–47) by 90 days. Its art. 49, which inserts art. 168-A §§ 5º–6º, falls under art. 58 II ('na data de sua publicação'). So nothing in arts. 121–212 is prospective by vacatio legis: the compiled text is the law in force. That includes Lei 15.517 (published 23.9.2026, six days before this sweep). Lei 15.229/2025 amended art. 171 § 5º III, which Lei 15.397/2026 then revoked along with all of § 5º, so it has no residue. Not covered: vetoes that Congress may yet override (S-sweep-b-03), bills not yet enacted, and any law published after the Senado metadata version of 29/09/2026 07:28.

searches.question: Is any presidential veto of a dispositivo in arts. 121–212 still awaiting deliberation in Congress, such that an override would change the text?
searches.scope: Congresso Nacional, 'Vetos — Em tramitação' (https://www.congressonacional.leg.br/materias/vetos), 111 vetoes listed. The detail pages of every pending veto whose ementa names the Código Penal were read: VET 52/2026, 36/2026, 23/2026, 20/2026 and 14/2026, VET 25/2025 and 12/2025, and VET 26/2024. Also Mensagem nº 365/2026 on the Câmara's legin page for Lei 15.397/2026.
searches.query: grep 'Código Penal|2.848' in the pending-veto list; read each detail page's 'Dispositivos vetados / resultado'
searches.coverage_note: Only VET 20/2026 and VET 52/2026 bear on arts. 121–212, both on art. 157. The other pending vetoes that touch the Code or its neighbours fall outside the range. VET 14/2026 (Lei 15.358) is on art. 91 II and arts. 2º §3/43 of the Lei itself. VET 25/2025 (Lei 15.181) is on Lei 9.613 art. 1º and its own art. 5º. VET 12/2025 (Lei 15.134) is on its own arts. 1º/2º/4º/5º and Leis 12.694 and 13.709. VET 23/2026 is on the LEP. VET 36/2026 (Lei 15.455) is on LC 150 art. 30-A. VET 26/2024 (Estatuto da Segurança Privada, which inserted art. 183-A) is on that Estatuto's own arts. 7º, 19, 20 and 71. Vetoes already deliberated were not re-checked against the compiled text beyond the fact that the 2019 overrides of art. 121 § 2º VIII and art. 141 § 2º appear in it as law. The Congress page lists only vetoes 'em tramitação'; a veto overridden and promulgated after the Senado metadata version would not be caught here.

searches.question: What do the instruments behind Vide markers V18, V23–V30 (Leis 4.611/1965, 10.446/2002, 7.209/1984, 1.521/1951 and 10.741/2003) do to arts. 121 § 3º, 129 § 6º, 148, 153, 154, 159, 177, 181 and 182?
searches.scope: Planalto texts: L4611.htm, L10446.htm, L7209.htm (arts. 2º and 5º), L1521.htm (art. 3º), L10.741.htm (arts. 95, 110, 118). The anchors Planalto's compiled Code links from each Vide were read in del2848compilado.htm: L7209.htm#art2., L10446.htm#art1i, L10.741.htm#art95, L1521.htm. V18/V23 carry no link.
searches.coverage_note: Lei 4.611/1965 (V18, V23) and Lei 10.446/2002 (V24, V27) are procedural and produce no entry; they are disposed directly below. Lei 4.611 is shown by Planalto as 'Revogada pela Lei nº 9.099, de 1995'. It had set the summary rite for arts. 121 § 3º and 129 § 6º. Lei 10.446 art. 1º I only lets the Polícia Federal investigate arts. 148 and 159 in stated circumstances. Neither changes an element, a penalty or the ação penal. Not covered: case law applying these statutes, and the CPP rite that replaced Lei 4.611.

searches.question: What has the STF decided, or is it deciding, about arts. 124–128 (abortion): ADPF 54, ADPF 1207 MC/DF (with ADPF 989), ADPF 442, and the 1st Turma's HC 124.306?
searches.scope: Attempted first: portal.stf.jus.br/processos/detalhe.asp?incidente=2226954 (ADPF 54) and =7153287 (ADPF 1207), jurisprudencia.stf.jus.br, noticias.stf.jus.br and redir.stf.jus.br. All returned HTTP 403 to curl, WebFetch and Chrome on 2026-09-29. Then read: the TJDFT's 'Aborto' page (jurisprudência em temas, pesquisa realizada em 25/3/2026), which quotes the ADPF 54 ementa, HC 124306 and HC 201727 QO (on ADPF 442); two dated Migalhas reports (18/19 and 25 October 2025) on ADPFs 989/1207; and IBDFAM (20/10/2025) on ADPF 442.
searches.coverage_note: Nothing was read from the STF's own site. ADPF 54 is quoted from TJDFT's reproduction; the acórdão's dispositivo and trânsito em julgado were not seen. For ADPF 442 and ADPF 1207 the latest dated evidence is October 2025 press, and web searches found no report of either being resumed or decided by 2026-09-29. The STF docket, which would settle that, was unreachable, so both are recorded as currency risks, not as settled. Not searched: ADPF 1141 (the CFM Resolução 2.378/2024 on asystole in legal abortion); ADI 5581; and bills such as PL 1904/2024. None of these is law, but a reader should know they were not looked at.

searches.question: Which STF súmulas (ordinary and vinculante) fix how arts. 121–212 are read, and are they in force?
searches.scope: LexML Brasil (Senado Federal) jurisprudence index, filtered to Súmula, one query per súmula number, read in Chrome because LexML serves a JS challenge. Candidates checked: STF 246, 521, 554, 603, 610 and 714; 521 is not recorded because LexML answered 503. Each hit carries its URN, e.g. urn:lex:br:supremo.tribunal.federal:sumula:2003-09-24;714.
searches.coverage_note: The candidates came from the sweep's own knowledge of the STF súmulas, not from reading the full enunciados list (the STF's PDF of súmulas 1–736 is on the blocked stf.jus.br). A relevant STF súmula outside this list could be missed. LexML shows the enunciado but not cancellation status; none of these is known to be cancelled, and that was not verified against the STF. No súmula vinculante bearing on arts. 121–212 was found; that absence is not checked against a full SV list either.

searches.question: Which STJ súmulas fix how arts. 121–212 are read, and which of them are cancelled?
searches.scope: STJ scon súmula pages (https://scon.stj.jus.br/SCON/sumstj/toc.jsp?livre='N'.num.&b=SUMU&thesaurus=JURIDICO&p=true), read by same-origin fetch in Chrome and decoded as ISO-8859-1, for N in 17, 24, 48, 73, 96, 107, 174, 244, 442, 443, 502, 511, 536, 542, 567, 574, 582, 588, 589, 600 and 610.
searches.coverage_note: Candidate numbers were chosen from knowledge and cross-checked against a secondary list (direitohd.com), which surfaced no further criminal súmula on these articles. scon's own free-text search returned unreliable hit lists and was not used as a completeness check. The STJ's official 'VerbetesSTJ.pdf' was not parsed. STJ Súmula 610 is civil law: it says suicide in the first two years of a life-insurance contract is not covered. It has nothing to do with arts. 121–212, and the latrocínio súmula meant under that number is the STF's (M-sweep-b-23). Súmula 174 is recorded as cancelled, as scon shows. Súmulas newer than those listed (2024–2026) were looked for by web search only.

searches.question: Which STJ repetitive themes and STF repercussão-geral theses fix the reading of arts. 121–212 (consummation of furto and roubo, the nocturnal increase, insignificance, arma branca, domestic entry)?
searches.scope: TJDFT 'Precedentes qualificados na visão do TJDFT' (direito penal: furto, roubo; direito processual penal: busca e apreensão domiciliar) and 'Jurisprudência em detalhes / dos crimes'. Each page quotes the thesis verbatim with its tema number. STJ Temas 934, 916, 1087, 1110, 1144 and 1205 and STF Tema 280 were read. processo.stj.jus.br/repetitivos returned an error page in Chrome and was not used.
searches.coverage_note: Coverage is whatever the TJDFT chose to catalogue, so a thesis it did not catalogue is missed. In particular, STF Tema 1.120 (RE 1.297.884, on the validity of Lei 13.654/2018 art. 4º, which revoked art. 157 § 2º I) was seen only as a search-result title, and its thesis was not read. No STJ theme on art. 180 (receptação) or art. 171 was looked for specifically. The TJDFT pages carry their own research dates (4/3/2024 to 23/10/2025), so a later revision of a thesis would be missed.

searches.scope: TST acórdão TST-RR-450-57.2017.5.23.0041 (https://jurisprudencia-backend2.tst.jus.br/rest/documentos/18d3f2da5d44b5bb60e06942dada53a1), which quotes the ementa of STF Inq 3412 in full with its DJe citation. searches.question: Has the STF ruled on the validity of any provision of arts. 138–145 (crimes against honour) or on the scope of art. 140 since the compiled text's amendments?
searches.scope: Web searches for STF ADI/ADPF on arts. 138–141 and for ADO 26 / MI 4733. Migalhas report of 5 February 2026 on ADPF 338 (https://www.migalhas.com.br/quentes/429923/stf-valida-pena-mais-alta-por-crime-contra-honra-de-agente-publico). Planalto's compiled Lei 7.716/1989, whose heading carries '(Vide ADO Nº 26)'.
searches.coverage_note: The STF's own pages were unreachable. ADPF 338 is known only through a dated press report, and the extension of ADO 26 / MI 4733 to injúria only through search-result summaries, which are not quoted. ADPF 130 (2009, non-reception of the Lei de Imprensa, Lei 5.250/1967, which the Senado lists as 'correlata' to arts. 138–144) was not fetched; its known effect is that the Code now governs press offences against honour. ADPF 779 (legítima defesa da honra) is sweep-a's, on arts. 23 and 25.

searches.question: Is there any authority or legislative correction on how art. 147-A § 1º II is to be read? It cites 'o § 2º-A do art. 121', which Lei 14.994/2024 revoked.
searches.scope: Planalto's text of Lei 14.994/2024 (arts. 1º and 9º); the Senado Notícias report of 10/12/2024 on PL 1.548/2023 at the Comissão de Segurança Pública; web searches for the bill's later progress and for case law on the reference.
searches.coverage_note: The dangling reference was confirmed from the statute. Lei 14.994/2024 art. 1º amended arts. 92, 129, 141 and 147 but not 147-A, and its art. 9º revoked art. 121 § 2º VI and §§ 2º-A and 7º. The only legislative material found is a Senate committee report of December 2024. The Senado's open-data API answered 503, so the bill's progress after that report is unknown. No court decision applying or refusing the § 1º II increase since October 2024 was found, but no STJ or TJ search by keyword was run for one.

searches.question: After EC 66/2010, does 'separação judicial' survive as a category? The STF answered in Tema 1053 (2023). What does that do to art. 182 I ('cônjuge desquitado ou judicialmente separado')? This was relayed from sweep-a, whose V6 marker points to Lei 6.515/1977.
searches.scope: TJRJ Portal do Conhecimento news of 09/11/2023, quoting the Tema 1053 thesis verbatim. TJMG's Tema 1053 page was read but is stale: it shows only the 2019 recognition of repercussão geral. STF pages returned 403.
searches.coverage_note: The thesis was read only through the TJRJ reproduction. No criminal case applying Tema 1053 to art. 182 I was searched for. Also not checked: whether de facto separated spouses are still 'na constância da sociedade conjugal' for art. 181 I, now that judicial separation no longer ends the sociedade conjugal for anyone new.

entries.summary: ADPF 54 (STF, Tribunal Pleno, julgado 12.4.2012) declared unconstitutional any reading under which interrupting the pregnancy of an anencephalic foetus is conduct typified in arts. 124, 126 and 128, I and II. The effect is erga omnes and binding (Lei 9.882/1999 art. 10 § 3º). So arts. 124 and 126 do not reach the interruption of a pregnancy of an anencephalic foetus, and art. 128 is not needed to excuse it. Planalto marks all three articles '(Vide ADPF 54)'. Arts. 125 (no consent) and 127 are not named.

provenance.source: TJDFT, Jurisprudência em temas › A doutrina na prática › Crimes em espécie › Aborto (última modificação 06/04/2026; pesquisa realizada em 25/3/2026), reproducing the ADPF 54 ementa. The STF's own process page (https://portal.stf.jus.br/processos/detalhe.asp?incidente=2226954, the target of Planalto's Vide link) returned HTTP 403 and was not read.

provenance.quote: Mostra-se inconstitucional interpretação de a interrupção da gravidez de feto anencéfalo ser conduta tipificada nos artigos 124, 126 e 128, incisos I e II, do Código Penal.

routing.rule_version_arm: arts. 124, 126 e 128 lidos conforme ADPF 54 (2012-04-12): não incidem sobre a interrupção da gravidez de feto anencéfalo

entries.disposition_note: The encoder of arts. 124–128 implements the arm. arts. 124 and 126 need an input for 'feto anencéfalo' that takes the conduct outside the type from 2012-04-12. The earlier arm is the text as enacted. Whether the read-down reaches art. 125, where there is no consent, is not stated by the quoted ementa. The encoder should REFUSE there rather than guess.

entries.summary: ADPF 1207 MC/DF (Planalto's '(Vide ADPF 1207 MC/DF)' at art. 128). On 17.10.2025 Min. Barroso granted, in ADPFs 989 and 1207, a partial liminar. It let nursing professionals take part in legal-abortion procedures (the art. 128 cases and anencephaly) and suspended proceedings against nurses who assisted. It also barred health bodies from imposing obstacles the law does not state, such as a gestational-age limit. On 24.10.2025 the Plenário, by 10 votes to 1 following Min. Gilmar Mendes, refused to refer the liminar, which therefore fell. Art. 128 ('praticado por médico') operates as written today. The merits are pending, which is the currency risk.

provenance.source: Migalhas (press), 'STF derruba liminar que autorizava enfermeiros a realizar aborto legal', sábado, 25 de outubro de 2025; and the same outlet's report of 18/19 October 2025 describing the liminar. The STF process page (incidente=7153287) returned HTTP 403.
provenance.citation: STF, ADPF 1207 MC-Ref/DF and ADPF 989 MC-Ref/DF, sessão virtual extraordinária encerrada em 24.10.2025
provenance.quote: Por maioria de 10 votos a 1, o STF decidiu, nesta sexta-feira, 24, revogar a liminar do ex-ministro Luís Roberto Barroso que permitia a enfermeiros e técnicos de enfermagem realizar abortos previstos em lei — como nos casos de estupro, risco à vida da gestante ou anencefalia fetal.

routing.effective_from_absent_reason: Nothing is scheduled. The liminar that would have widened art. 128 beyond 'médico' fell on 2025-10-24, and the merits of ADPFs 989/1207 are undecided with no date found. The STF docket could not be read to confirm the status on 2026-09-29.

entries.disposition_note: Art. 128 is encoded as written: the exemption covers abortion 'praticado por médico'. The entry records that a pending constitutional action targets exactly that word, so a later merits ruling could change who may perform a legal abortion without penal consequence.

entries.summary: ADPF 442 (PSOL, 2017) asks the STF to hold that arts. 124 and 126 were not received by the 1988 Constitution as far as they reach voluntary interruption of pregnancy in the first 12 weeks. The relatora (Rosa Weber, September 2023) and Min. Barroso (October 2025, his last day) voted for it. The judgment was suspended by a pedido de destaque of Min. Gilmar Mendes and was reported as having no date to resume. Still pending as far as could be established; if decided for the petitioner, arts. 124/126 would be read down for the first trimester.

provenance.source: Migalhas (press), 25 de outubro de 2025 (same report as M-sweep-b-02); TJDFT 'Aborto' page quoting STF HC 201727 QO (1ª Turma, 08-08-2023), which suspended a habeas corpus pending ADPF 442; IBDFAM news of 20/10/2025.
provenance.citation: STF, ADPF 442, Rel. orig. Min. Rosa Weber; HC 201727 QO, Rel. Roberto Barroso, Primeira Turma, julgado em 08-08-2023, DJe 16-08-2023
provenance.quote: Antes de deixar o tribunal, o ministro também votou pela descriminalização do aborto até a 12ª semana de gravidez, julgamento que está suspenso após pedido de destaque feito por Gilmar Mendes e ainda sem data para ser retomado.

routing.effective_from_absent_reason: Pending constitutional action with no judgment date. The latest dated evidence fetched is October 2025; the STF docket was unreachable on 2026-09-29.

entries.disposition_note: Nothing to encode until the STF decides. Arts. 124 and 126 apply at every gestational age, subject to ADPF 54 (M-sweep-b-01) and art. 128. The contested first-trimester reading is fork F-sweep-b-01 (via M-sweep-b-04).

entries.summary: In HC 124.306 (2016) the STF's 1ª Turma, by majority, gave arts. 124–126 an 'interpretação conforme' excluding voluntary interruption of pregnancy in the first trimester. The ruling bound only that case: it has no erga omnes effect, and the question is the object of the still-pending ADPF 442 (M-sweep-b-03). It is recorded because it shows a reading of arts. 124–126 that part of the STF has adopted.

provenance.source: TJDFT, Jurisprudência em temas › Crimes em espécie › Aborto (pesquisa realizada em 25/3/2026), reproducing the ementa of HC 124306

provenance.quote: 3. Em segundo lugar, é preciso conferir interpretação conforme a Constituição aos próprios arts. 124 a 126 do Código Penal – que tipificam o crime de aborto – para excluir do seu âmbito de incidência a interrupção voluntária da gestação efetivada no primeiro trimestre.

entries.summary: Veto VET 20/2026 is pending. Lei 15.397/2026 would have raised the penalty for roubo resulting in lesão corporal grave (art. 157 § 3º I) to reclusão of 16 to 24 years and multa. That dispositivo was vetoed (Mensagem nº 365/2026), because it would have put the minimum above homicídio qualificado's. The veto is 'Não Apreciado' in Congress and has been sobrestando a pauta since 04/06/2026. Art. 157 § 3º I therefore keeps its Lei 13.654/2018 text: reclusão of 7 to 18 years and multa. If Congress overrides the veto, the vetoed text would be promulgated and take effect on publication.

provenance.source: Congresso Nacional, Veto nº 20/2026 detail page ('Dispositivos vetados / resultado', 20.26.001); Câmara dos Deputados legin, Mensagem nº 365, de 30 de abril de 2026

provenance.quote: lesão corporal grave, a pena é de reclusão, de 16 (dezesseis) a 24 (vinte e quatro) anos, e multa;

routing.effective_from_absent_reason: The veto awaits deliberation in a joint session of Congress with no date set. If it is overridden, the promulgated text takes effect on publication, on a date nobody can predict today.

entries.disposition_note: Encode art. 157 § 3º I as compiled: reclusão 7–18 anos, e multa. This is the entry to re-check before any re-currency pass.

entries.summary: Lei 7.209/1984 art. 2º cancels every fixed fine amount in the Parte Especial and replaces 'multa de' with 'multa'. From the Lei's vigência (six months after its DOU publication of 13.7.1984) the réis ranges printed in art. 129 § 5º ('de duzentos mil réis a dois contos de réis'), art. 153 caput ('de trezentos mil réis a dois contos de réis') and art. 154 caput ('de um conto a dez contos de réis') are not law. The multa in each is the day-fine of the Parte Geral (art. 49 and following). Planalto flags arts. 153 and 154 with '(Vide Lei nº 7.209, de 1984)' linked to L7209.htm#art2. Art. 129 § 5º carries no flag, although the same article applies to it.

provenance.source: Planalto, Lei nº 7.209, de 11 de julho de 1984, arts. 2º and 5º
provenance.citation: Lei nº 7.209/1984, art. 2º; art. 5º ('Esta lei entra em vigor seis meses após a data de sua publicação'); DOU 13.7.1984
provenance.quote: Art 2º - São canceladas, na Parte Especial do Código Penal e nas leis especiais alcançadas pelo art. 12 do Código Penal, quaisquer referências a valores de multas, substituindo-se a expressão multa de por multa.

routing.rule_version_arm: multa sem valores em réis (Lei 7.209/1984 art. 2º; vigência seis meses após o DOU de 13.7.1984) — arts. 129 § 5º, 153 caput, 154 caput

entries.disposition_note: The encoders of arts. 129 § 5º, 153 and 154 encode the multa as the Parte Geral's day-fine and never as the réis range. The réis wording is quoted for isomorphism but is inert. No earlier arm is needed unless the encoding models pre-1985 facts.

entries.summary: Lei 10.741/2003 (Estatuto da Pessoa Idosa) art. 95 makes its own crimes ação pública incondicionada and says arts. 181 and 182 do not apply to them. Planalto's '(Vide Lei nº 10.741, de 2003)' at arts. 181 and 182 links to exactly this article (L10.741.htm#art95). For the Code's own Título II crimes, the same Lei's art. 110 inserted art. 183 III (victim aged 60 or more), which is already in the compiled text.

provenance.source: Planalto, Lei nº 10.741, de 1º de outubro de 2003, arts. 95, 110 and 118
provenance.citation: Lei nº 10.741/2003, art. 95; art. 110 (inserting CP art. 183 III); art. 118 (vigência 90 days after publication)
provenance.quote: Art. 95. Os crimes definidos nesta Lei são de ação penal pública incondicionada, não se lhes aplicando os arts. 181 e 182 do Código Penal.

entries.disposition_note: Arts. 181–182 already reach only 'crimes previstos neste título' (Título II). Art. 95 restricts them for crimes defined outside the Code, which this encoding does not encode. The substance that concerns the Code's own crimes, art. 183 III, is compiled text. So nothing computes differently in this encoding.

entries.summary: Art. 177 caput and § 1º apply only 'se o fato não constitui crime contra a economia popular'. Planalto's Vide at § 1º points to Lei 1.521/1951 (crimes against the economia popular), whose art. 3º VII (false statements in prospectuses for the sale of shares) and X (fraud in company books and reports to shareholders) cover part of the same ground. So art. 177 yields to Lei 1.521 art. 3º where both fit.

provenance.source: Planalto, Lei nº 1.521, de 26 de dezembro de 1951, art. 3º
provenance.citation: Lei nº 1.521/1951, art. 3º, VII and X
provenance.quote: VII - dar indicações ou fazer afirmações falsas em prospectos ou anúncios, para fim de substituição, compra ou venda de títulos, ações ou quotas;

entries.disposition_note: The subsidiarity is already in art. 177's text. The encoder takes 'o fato constitui crime contra a economia popular' as an input fact and does not encode Lei 1.521. Lei 7.492/1986 (financial-system crimes, Vide V9, sweep-a's) may also displace art. 177 § 1º for financial institutions; that was not swept here.

entries.summary: Lei 8.072/1990 art. 9º adds half to the penalties of arts. 157 § 3º, 158 § 2º and 159 caput and §§ 1º–3º (capped at 30 years) when the victim is in any situation of art. 224. Art. 224 was revoked by Lei 12.015/2009 art. 7º (in force 10.8.2009). Art. 9º has not been expressly revoked and still stands on Planalto. Planalto's compiled Code points to it five times in this range, with unparenthesised 'Vide Lei nº 8.072, de 25.7.90' pointers at lines 1190, 1195, 1197, 1199 and 1201 of codigo-penal-1940.txt (arts. 158 § 2º, 159 caput and §§ 1º–3º), all linked to L8072.htm#art9. The first vide-index.tsv missed these pointers because it captured only '(Vide …)'. The conductor has since inventoried them as V34–V38. On the text alone, the increase has no operative condition since 2009. Whether it survives against a 'vulnerável' victim (art. 217-A) is a reading, not a text; the courts' position was not fetched.

provenance.source: Planalto, Lei nº 8.072, de 25 de julho de 1990, art. 9º; Planalto, Lei nº 12.015, de 7 de agosto de 2009, art. 7º
provenance.citation: Lei nº 8.072/1990, art. 9º; Lei nº 12.015/2009, art. 7º ('Revogam-se os arts. 214, 216, 223, 224 e 232 do Decreto-Lei no 2.848, de 7 de dezembro de 1940 - Código Penal, e a Lei no 2.252, de 1o de julho de 1954.')
provenance.quote: Art. 9º As penas fixadas no art. 6º para os crimes capitulados nos arts. 157, § 3º, 158, § 2º, 159, caput e seus §§ 1º, 2º e 3º, 213, caput e sua combinação com o art. 223, caput e parágrafo único, 214 e sua combinação com o art. 223, caput e parágrafo único, todos do Código Penal, são acrescidas de metade, respeitado o limite superior de trinta anos de reclusão, estando a vítima em qualquer das hipóteses referidas no art. 224 também do Código Penal.

entries.disposition_note: The encoders of arts. 157–159 create F-sweep-b-02. The five bare pointers are now markers V34–V38, and this entry disposes of them.

entries.summary: Art. 168-A has an external punibility regime. Art. 168-A § 2º extinguishes punishability only for spontaneous payment 'antes do início da ação fiscal'. Two statutes outside the Code go further. Lei 10.684/2003 art. 9º § 2º extinguishes punishability of art. 168-A whenever the related legal entity pays the debt in full, with no time limit, and art. 9º caput suspends the pretensão punitiva during parcelamento. Lei 9.430/1996 art. 83 (as amended by Lei 12.382/2011) suspends the pretensão during parcelamento only if requested before the denúncia is received, and extinguishes punishability on full payment of the parcelled debt (§ 4º). LC 225/2026 excludes the declared 'devedor contumaz' from all three: CP art. 168-A §§ 5º–6º, Lei 10.684 art. 9º §§ 3º–4º and Lei 9.430 art. 83 § 5º II and § 7º. The Code's text alone would give the wrong answer for payment after the ação fiscal has begun.

provenance.source: Planalto, Lei nº 10.684, de 30 de maio de 2003, art. 9º (with §§ 3º–4º 'Incluído pela Lei Complementar nº 225, de 2026'); Planalto, Lei nº 9.430, de 27 de dezembro de 1996, art. 83 §§ 1º–7º
provenance.citation: Lei nº 10.684/2003, art. 9º caput and §§ 1º–4º; Lei nº 9.430/1996, art. 83 §§ 2º, 4º, 5º, 7º (redação da Lei 12.382/2011 e da LC 225/2026)
provenance.quote: § 2o Extingue-se a punibilidade dos crimes referidos neste artigo quando a pessoa jurídica relacionada com o agente efetuar o pagamento integral dos débitos oriundos de tributos e contribuições sociais, inclusive acessórios.

entries.disposition_note: The encoder of art. 168-A encodes extinction by payment as an additional ground beside § 2º and creates F-sweep-b-03. That fork covers how the two statutes relate: whether payment works at any time or only for parcelled debts, and whether it works up to trânsito em julgado. Both statutes and LC 225's carve-outs are in force (S-sweep-b-02). Courts' reconciliation of them was not fetched.

entries.summary: Lei 13.869/2019 (abuso de autoridade) bears on art. 150 in three ways. Its art. 22 makes it a separate crime for a public agent to enter a dwelling without judicial order or outside the legal conditions, and the same law revoked art. 150 § 2º, which had covered public officials. Its art. 22 § 1º III gives a statutory hour window, 21h to 5h, for executing domestic search warrants. That is the only statutory measure of 'dia' and 'noite' bearing on art. 150 § 1º ('durante a noite') and § 3º I ('durante o dia'). Its art. 22 § 2º says there is no crime where 'fundados indícios' show entry was needed because of flagrante delito.

provenance.source: Planalto, Lei nº 13.869, de 5 de setembro de 2019, art. 22
provenance.citation: Lei nº 13.869/2019, art. 22 caput, § 1º III and § 2º; CP art. 150 § 2º '(Revogado pela Lei nº 13.869, de 2019)' in the compiled text
provenance.quote: III - cumpre mandado de busca e apreensão domiciliar após as 21h (vinte e uma horas) ou antes das 5h (cinco horas).

entries.disposition_note: The encoder of art. 150 creates F-sweep-b-04. It covers two questions: whether art. 150 applies to a public agent acting as such, given Lei 13.869 art. 22; and how 'dia'/'noite' are measured.

entries.summary: STF Tema 280 (RE 603.616, repercussão geral) holds forced entry into a home without a warrant lawful, even at night, only when based on 'fundadas razões', justified afterwards, indicating flagrante delito inside. Art. 150 § 3º II excludes the crime 'quando algum crime está sendo ali praticado ou na iminência de o ser'. Tema 280 is a thesis on CF art. 5º XI and on the validity of evidence. It measures lawfulness by the founded reasons available beforehand, not by whether a crime was in fact under way, and so bears on how § 3º II is read.

provenance.source: TJDFT, Precedentes qualificados na visão do TJDFT › Direito processual penal › Busca e apreensão domiciliar › Tema 280 do STF (última modificação 24/10/2025; pesquisa realizada em 23/10/2025)
provenance.citation: STF, Tema 280 da repercussão geral (RE 603.616)
provenance.quote: A entrada forçada em domicílio sem mandado judicial só é lícita, mesmo em período noturno, quando amparada em fundadas razões, devidamente justificadas a posteriori, que indiquem que dentro da casa ocorre situação de flagrante delito, sob pena de responsabilidade disciplinar, civil e penal do agente ou da autoridade, e de nulidade dos atos praticados.

entries.disposition_note: The encoder of art. 150 creates F-sweep-b-05 on the § 3º II standard: an actual or imminent crime (the text), or founded reasons judged beforehand (Tema 280; Lei 13.869 art. 22 § 2º).

entries.summary: Two later special statutes cover parts of art. 151's ground with their own penalties. Lei 6.538/1978 art. 40 (postal services) repeats art. 151 caput's wording for 'correspondência fechada' ('Devassar indevidamente…'), and its § 1º covers art. 151 § 1º I, with a lighter and different penalty. Lei 9.472/1997 art. 183 punishes clandestine telecommunications activity with detenção of 2 to 4 years, the ground of art. 151 § 1º IV. Planalto's header Vide V7 points to Lei 6.538; the marker is sweep-a's. Whether art. 151 caput, § 1º I and § 1º IV are still operative, or were displaced by the later special law, is a reading the Code's text does not settle.

provenance.source: Planalto, Lei nº 6.538, de 22 de junho de 1978, art. 40; Planalto, Lei nº 9.472, de 16 de julho de 1997, art. 183
provenance.citation: Lei nº 6.538/1978, art. 40 caput and §§ 1º–2º; Lei nº 9.472/1997, art. 183 ('Desenvolver clandestinamente atividades de telecomunicação: Pena - detenção de dois a quatro anos, aumentada da metade se houver dano a terceiro, e multa de R$ 10.000,00 (dez mil reais).')
provenance.quote: Art. 40 - Devassar indevidamente o conteúdo de correspondência fechada dirigida a outrem: Pena: detenção, até seis meses, ou pagamento não excedente a vinte dias-multa.

entries.disposition_note: The encoder of art. 151 creates F-sweep-b-06. Neither statute says it revokes art. 151. Any displacement is by speciality or implied repeal, and no court ruling on it was fetched.

entries.summary: Lei 8.906/1994 art. 7º § 2º (EOAB) used to extend art. 142 I for advocates: their statements made 'em juízo ou fora dele' did not constitute punishable injúria or difamação. Planalto now shows that § 2º as '(Revogado)' by Lei 14.365/2022, with '(Vide ADI 7231)'. What remains is EOAB art. 2º § 3º: the advocate 'é inviolável por seus atos e manifestações, nos limites desta lei'. So there is no statutory extension of art. 142 I today. ADI 7231 against the revocation is pending as far as is known, and its status was not fetched.

provenance.source: Planalto, Lei nº 8.906, de 4 de julho de 1994 (EOAB), art. 7º § 2º (struck text and revogação), art. 2º § 3º
provenance.citation: Lei nº 8.906/1994, art. 7º § 2º, revogado pela Lei nº 14.365/2022 (Vide ADI 7231); former text also subject to ADI 1.127
provenance.quote: § 2º (Revogado). (Redação dada pela Lei nº 14.365, de 2022) (Vide ADI 7231)

entries.disposition_note: Encode art. 142 I as written, limited to 'a ofensa irrogada em juízo, na discussão da causa'. This is recorded so that no encoder imports the pre-2022 EOAB immunity, and because ADI 7231 could restore it.

entries.summary: The Code states no ação penal for art. 129's lesão corporal. Lei 9.099/1995 art. 88 makes the action for lesões corporais leves and lesões culposas depend on representação. For violence against women in a domestic setting, Lei 11.340/2006 art. 41 disapplies Lei 9.099 altogether. STJ Súmula 542 therefore holds the action for lesão corporal from domestic violence against a woman to be pública incondicionada; the STF held the same in ADI 4424, which was not fetched. The Code's text leaves the ação penal of art. 129 caput and § 6º undetermined, and these external rules fix it.

provenance.source: Planalto, Lei nº 9.099/1995, art. 88; Planalto, Lei nº 11.340/2006, art. 41; STJ, Súmula 542 (scon)
provenance.citation: Lei nº 9.099/1995, art. 88; Lei nº 11.340/2006, art. 41 ('Aos crimes praticados com violência doméstica e familiar contra a mulher, independentemente da pena prevista, não se aplica a Lei nº 9.099, de 26 de setembro de 1995.'); STJ Súmula 542 ('A ação penal relativa ao crime de lesão corporal resultante de violência doméstica contra a mulher é pública incondicionada.' TERCEIRA SEÇÃO, julgado em 26/08/2015, DJe 31/08/2015)
provenance.quote: Art. 88. Além das hipóteses do Código Penal e da legislação especial, dependerá de representação a ação penal relativa aos crimes de lesões corporais leves e lesões culposas.

entries.disposition_note: The encoder of art. 129 encodes the ação penal from these sources, not from the Code, and creates F-sweep-b-07. The fork covers where the line falls for § 9º (domestic setting, victim not a woman), § 13 and the qualified forms that are not 'leves'.

entries.summary: Art. 121-A § 1º I defines the feminicídio motive as a crime involving 'violência doméstica e familiar' and does not define the phrase. Arts. 129 § 13, 141 § 3º and 147 § 1º incorporate § 1º by reference. The phrase is defined in Lei 11.340/2006 art. 5º (acts based on gender, in the domestic unit, the family, or any intimate relationship 'independentemente de coabitação'). STJ Súmula 600 confirms that cohabitation is not required. Art. 129 § 9º, by contrast, has its own list of relationships and does not use the Lei 11.340 definition.

provenance.source: STJ, Súmula 600 (scon); Planalto, Lei nº 11.340/2006, art. 5º
provenance.citation: STJ Súmula 600 (TERCEIRA SEÇÃO, julgado em 22/11/2017, DJe 27/11/2017); Lei nº 11.340/2006, art. 5º I–III ('III - em qualquer relação íntima de afeto, na qual o agressor conviva ou tenha convivido com a ofendida, independentemente de coabitação.')
provenance.quote: Para a configuração da violência doméstica e familiar prevista no artigo 5º da Lei n. 11.340/2006 (Lei Maria da Penha) não se exige a coabitação entre autor e vítima.

entries.disposition_note: The encoder of art. 121-A creates F-sweep-b-08 on whether § 1º I imports Lei 11.340 art. 5º, including its gender-basis clause.

entries.summary: Lei 11.340/2006 art. 7º IV names 'violência patrimonial', including the 'subtração' and destruction of a woman's goods, as a form of domestic and family violence against women. It does not mention arts. 181–183. Whether art. 181's absolute immunity (spouse during the marriage; ascendant or descendant) and art. 182's representação still apply to Título II crimes committed as patrimonial violence against a woman is contested. Art. 183 withholds the immunity only for violence or grave threat against the person, for a stranger taking part, and for a victim aged 60 or more. The STJ's position was not fetched.

provenance.source: Planalto, Lei nº 11.340, de 7 de agosto de 2006, art. 7º IV
provenance.citation: Lei nº 11.340/2006, art. 7º IV
provenance.quote: IV - a violência patrimonial, entendida como qualquer conduta que configure retenção, subtração, destruição parcial ou total de seus objetos, instrumentos de trabalho, documentos pessoais, bens, valores e direitos ou recursos econômicos, incluindo os destinados a satisfazer suas necessidades;

entries.disposition_note: The encoder of arts. 181–183 creates F-sweep-b-09. Whether 'cônjuge' in art. 181 I reaches a companheiro in união estável belongs in the same fork, once a citation is found. The art. 182 I question (desquitado or judicially separated, after STF Tema 1053) is now its own fork, F-sweep-b-23 (M-sweep-b-45).

entries.summary: STF Inq 3412 (Plenário, 2012): art. 149 does not require proof of physical coercion or of restriction of freedom of movement. Subjecting the victim to forced labour, an exhausting working day or degrading working conditions suffices, these being alternative conducts of the type. Not every breach of labour rights counts: the breach must be intense and persistent.

provenance.source: TST, acórdão TST-RR-450-57.2017.5.23.0041, quoting the STF ementa in full

provenance.quote: Para configuração do crime do art. 149 do Código Penal, não é necessário que se prove a coação física da liberdade de ir e vir ou mesmo o cerceamento da liberdade de locomoção, bastando a submissão da vítima "a trabalhos forçados ou a jornada exaustiva" ou "a condições degradantes de trabalho", condutas alternativas previstas no tipo penal.

entries.disposition_note: The encoder of art. 149 creates F-sweep-b-10 and settles it with this entry. The four 'quer…' modes are alternatives, and restraint of movement is only one of them. The ementa's 'intensa e persistente' threshold is a judgement input, not a computed one.

entries.summary: Planalto heads Lei 7.716/1989 (crimes of racial prejudice) with '(Vide ADO Nº 26)'. In ADO 26 / MI 4733 (2019) the STF brought homophobic and transphobic conduct within the Lei 7.716 crimes. Since Lei 14.532/2023 moved injúria racial out of art. 140 § 3º into Lei 7.716 art. 2º-A (reclusão 2–5 anos), an insult 'em razão de raça, cor, etnia ou procedência nacional' is no longer art. 140. Secondary sources report that the STF extended ADO 26 / MI 4733 to homotransphobic injúria. On that reading, insults based on sexual orientation or gender identity fall under Lei 7.716 art. 2º-A, not art. 140 caput. That extension was NOT verified against an STF text, because the STF was unreachable.

provenance.source: Planalto, Lei nº 7.716, de 5 de janeiro de 1989 (texto compilado), heading '(Vide ADO Nº 26)' and art. 2º-A
provenance.citation: Lei nº 7.716/1989, art. 2º-A (incluído pela Lei nº 14.532/2023); STF ADO 26 / MI 4733 (not fetched)
provenance.quote: Art. 2º-A Injuriar alguém, ofendendo-lhe a dignidade ou o decoro, em razão de raça, cor, etnia ou procedência nacional.

entries.disposition_note: The encoder of art. 140 creates F-sweep-b-11 on whether art. 140 caput reaches an injúria whose motive is the victim's sexual orientation or gender identity. The citation for the displacing reading must be fetched before the fork is settled.

entries.summary: STF Súmula 714 covers crimes against the honour of a public servant committed because of the servant's functions. Art. 145 parágrafo único makes such an action depend on the victim's representação to the Ministério Público. The súmula adds a concurrent route: the victim may also bring a private action by queixa.

provenance.source: LexML Brasil (Senado Federal), jurisprudence index, Súmula nº 714 do STF (URN urn:lex:br:supremo.tribunal.federal:sumula:2003-09-24;714)
provenance.quote: É CONCORRENTE A LEGITIMIDADE DO OFENDIDO, MEDIANTE QUEIXA, E DO MINISTÉRIO PÚBLICO, CONDICIONADA À REPRESENTAÇÃO DO OFENDIDO, PARA A AÇÃO PENAL POR CRIME CONTRA A HONRA DE SERVIDOR PÚBLICO EM RAZÃO DO EXERCÍCIO DE SUAS FUNÇÕES.

entries.disposition_note: The encoder of art. 145 creates F-sweep-b-12 and settles it with this entry. For art. 141 II (servidor em razão das funções) the ação penal is both 'condicionada à representação' and 'privada', at the victim's choice. The fork should say whether it also reaches the Presidents of the Senado, Câmara and STF added to art. 141 II in 2021. The súmula (2003) predates that addition.

entries.summary: Two STF súmulas bear on art. 171 § 2º VI (fraude no pagamento por meio de cheque). Súmula 246: without fraud there is no crime, so issuing a cheque without funds is not enough on its own. Súmula 554: payment of the cheque after the denúncia is received does not stop the prosecution. By implication, payment before that point is treated as excluding the prosecution; that implication is the reading, not the súmula's words.

provenance.source: LexML Brasil (Senado Federal), Súmulas nº 246 and 554 do STF
provenance.citation: STF, Súmula 246, 13/12/1963 (urn:lex:br:supremo.tribunal.federal:sumula:1963-12-13;246); STF, Súmula 554, 15/12/1976 (urn:lex:br:supremo.tribunal.federal:sumula:1976-12-15;554: 'O PAGAMENTO DE CHEQUE EMITIDO SEM PROVISÃO DE FUNDOS, APÓS O RECEBIMENTO DA DENÚNCIA, NÃO OBSTA AO PROSSEGUIMENTO DA AÇÃO PENAL.')
provenance.quote: COMPROVADO NÃO TER HAVIDO FRAUDE, NÃO SE CONFIGURA O CRIME DE EMISSÃO DE CHEQUE SEM FUNDOS.

entries.disposition_note: The encoder of art. 171 creates F-sweep-b-13. It covers two things: that fraud is required for § 2º VI (Súmula 246), and the effect of payment before the denúncia is received (Súmula 554's a contrario, which is jurisprudential and not in the Code). Since Lei 15.397/2026 revoked § 5º, estelionato is back to pública incondicionada by default. That is in the compiled text and is noted here only because Súmula 554 operates inside it.

entries.summary: STF Súmula 610: there is latrocínio (art. 157 § 3º II) when the killing is consummated, even if the agent takes nothing from the victim. The consummation of the § 3º II form turns on the death, not on the subtraction.

provenance.source: LexML Brasil (Senado Federal), Súmula nº 610 do STF (urn:lex:br:supremo.tribunal.federal:sumula:1984-10-17;610)
provenance.quote: HÁ CRIME DE LATROCÍNIO, QUANDO O HOMICÍDIO SE CONSUMA, AINDA QUE NÃO REALIZE O AGENTE A SUBTRAÇÃO DE BENS DA VÍTIMA.

entries.disposition_note: The encoder of art. 157 creates F-sweep-b-14 and settles it with this entry: § 3º II is consummated with the death, even when the subtraction is only attempted.

entries.summary: STJ Súmula 582, and STJ repetitive Tema 916 with the same text: roubo (art. 157) is consummated when possession is inverted by violence or grave threat, even briefly and even when the thing is recovered after immediate pursuit. Peaceful, unwatched possession is not required.

provenance.source: STJ, Súmula 582 (scon); TJDFT page for Tema 916 (pesquisa realizada em 22/1/2024)
provenance.citation: STJ Súmula 582, TERCEIRA SEÇÃO, julgado em 14/09/2016, DJe 19/09/2016; STJ Tema repetitivo 916
provenance.quote: Consuma-se o crime de roubo com a inversão da posse do bem mediante emprego de violência ou grave ameaça, ainda que por breve tempo e em seguida à perseguição imediata ao agente e recuperação da coisa roubada, sendo prescindível a posse mansa e pacífica ou desvigiada.

entries.disposition_note: The encoder of art. 157 creates F-sweep-b-15 (moment of consummation), settled by this entry. It matters wherever the encoding separates tentativa (art. 14 II, sweep-a's) from consumação.

entries.summary: STJ Súmula 96: extorsão (art. 158) is consummated whether or not the undue advantage is obtained. It is a formal crime, complete when the victim is constrained to act, to tolerate or to refrain.

provenance.source: STJ, Súmula 96 (scon)
provenance.citation: STJ Súmula 96, TERCEIRA SEÇÃO, julgado em 03/03/1994, DJ 10/03/1994, p. 4021
provenance.quote: O crime de extorsão consuma-se independentemente da obtenção da vantagem indevida.

entries.disposition_note: The encoder of art. 158 creates F-sweep-b-16, settled by this entry: obtaining the vantagem is not an element of consummation.

entries.summary: STJ repetitive Tema 934 (REsp 1.524.450/RJ): furto (art. 155) is consummated with de facto possession of the thing, even briefly and followed by pursuit. Peaceful, unwatched possession is not required.

provenance.source: TJDFT, Precedentes qualificados na visão do TJDFT › Direito penal › Furto › Tema 934 do STJ (pesquisa realizada em 4/3/2024)
provenance.citation: STJ, Tema repetitivo 934 (REsp 1.524.450/RJ)
provenance.quote: Consuma-se o crime de furto com a posse de fato da res furtiva, ainda que por breve espaço de tempo e seguida de perseguição ao agente, sendo prescindível a posse mansa e pacífica ou desvigiada.

entries.disposition_note: The encoder of art. 155 creates F-sweep-b-17, settled by this entry.

entries.summary: STJ Súmula 511: the privilégio of art. 155 § 2º (first offender, small value) can apply to furto qualificado when the qualifying circumstance is objective. Since 2025–2026 art. 155 has many more qualified forms (§§ 4º-A, 4º-B, 5º–10). Only § 8º says expressly that § 2º applies 'em qualquer caso'. For the rest the objective/subjective test of Súmula 511 decides, and the súmula (2014) predates most of them.

provenance.source: STJ, Súmula 511 (scon)
provenance.citation: STJ Súmula 511, TERCEIRA SEÇÃO, julgado em 11/06/2014, DJe 16/06/2014
provenance.quote: É possível o reconhecimento do privilégio previsto no § 2º do art. 155 do CP nos casos de crime de furto qualificado, se estiverem presentes a primariedade do agente, o pequeno valor da coisa e a qualificadora for de ordem objetiva.

entries.disposition_note: The encoder of art. 155 creates F-sweep-b-18. It should classify each qualifying circumstance as objective or subjective. § 4º II 'abuso de confiança' is the classic subjective one. Articles that incorporate art. 155 § 2º (arts. 170, 171 § 1º, 175 § 2º) inherit the question.

entries.summary: STJ repetitive Tema 1087 (3ª Seção, 2022): the art. 155 § 1º increase for furto during the 'repouso noturno' does not apply to furto qualificado under § 4º. Nocturnal commission may still weigh at the first phase of sentencing. The thesis predates Lei 15.397/2026, which rewrote § 1º (now 'aumenta-se de metade') and added §§ 5º–10. The topographic argument, § 1º coming before the qualified forms, survives the rewrite. The thesis names only § 4º, and whether it reaches §§ 4º-A to 10 is a reading.

provenance.source: TJDFT, Precedentes qualificados na visão do TJDFT › Direito penal › Furto › Tema 1087 do STJ (última modificação 18/03/2024; pesquisa realizada em 4/3/2024)
provenance.citation: STJ, Tema repetitivo 1.087 (REsp 1.890.981/SP and others)
provenance.quote: A causa de aumento prevista no § 1° do art. 155 do Código Penal (prática do crime de furto no período noturno) não incide no crime de furto na sua forma qualificada (§ 4°).

entries.disposition_note: The encoder of art. 155 creates F-sweep-b-19. currency_risk is true because the thesis was fixed on the pre-2026 § 1º (1/3), and no ruling after Lei 15.397/2026 was found.

entries.summary: STJ repetitive Tema 1144 defines 'repouso noturno' in art. 155 § 1º. It is the period when the population withdraws to rest, judged case by case, and it requires the calm of night that lowers vigilance or resistance. It is irrelevant whether the victims were asleep or whether the place was a shop, a street, an empty house or a vehicle. Item 1 of the thesis states the increase as 'um terço'; Lei 15.397/2026 made it 'metade', so item 1 is superseded as to the fraction only.

provenance.source: TJDFT, Precedentes qualificados na visão do TJDFT › Direito penal › Furto › Tema 1144 do STJ (última modificação 15/07/2024; pesquisa realizada em 28/6/2024)
provenance.citation: STJ, Tema repetitivo 1.144
provenance.quote: 4. São irrelevantes os fatos das vítimas estarem ou não dormindo no momento do crime, ou o local de sua ocorrência, em estabelecimento comercial, via pública, residência desabitada ou em veículos, bastando que o furto ocorra, obrigatoriamente, à noite e em situação de repouso.

entries.disposition_note: The encoder of art. 155 creates F-sweep-b-20. 'Repouso noturno' is a judgement input, and the fork records the Tema 1144 criteria the judge applies. The fraction comes from the compiled § 1º (metade), never from item 1 of the thesis.

entries.summary: Insignificância (bagatela) is judge-made material atypicality, most often argued in furto. Its STF vectors (HC 84.412) are minimal offensiveness, no social dangerousness, very low reprovability and an inexpressive legal injury. STJ Tema 1205 adds that immediate and full return of the stolen good is not enough on its own. Local courts use a value parameter (e.g. TJDFT: 10% of the minimum wage) and weigh recidivism. STJ Súmula 589 excludes insignificance in domestic violence against women (M-sweep-b-42). None of this is in the Code's text, but it decides many furto cases.

provenance.source: TJDFT, Precedentes qualificados › Direito penal › Furto › Tema 1205 do STJ (última modificação 24/10/2025); TJDFT, Jurisprudência em detalhes › Dos crimes › Princípio da insignificância — furto simples — requisitos (tema atualizado em 22/3/2023), quoting TJDFT Acórdão 1667847 on STF HC 84.412/SP
provenance.citation: STJ, Tema repetitivo 1.205; STF, HC 84.412/SP (Rel. Min. Celso de Mello), as reproduced by TJDFT
provenance.quote: A restituição imediata e integral do bem furtado não constitui, por si só, motivo suficiente para a incidência do princípio da insignificância.

entries.disposition_note: The encoder of art. 155 creates F-sweep-b-21. Under the brief's 'judgement stays with the judge' rule the likely taken reading is an input fact (conduct materially insignificant, as found by the court), not a computed threshold.

entries.summary: STJ Súmula 442: furto qualificado by concurso de pessoas (art. 155 § 4º IV) cannot borrow roubo's majorante for concurso (art. 157 § 2º II). The penalty is § 4º's own.

provenance.source: STJ, Súmula 442 (scon)
provenance.citation: STJ Súmula 442, TERCEIRA SEÇÃO, julgado em 28/04/2010, DJe 13/05/2010
provenance.quote: É inadmissível aplicar, no furto qualificado, pelo concurso de agentes, a majorante do roubo.

entries.disposition_note: An isomorphic encoding applies § 4º's own cominação anyway. The súmula forbids a cross-article analogy the encoding would not make. Recorded so a reviewer knows the question is closed.

entries.summary: STJ Súmula 443: the increase at the third phase for roubo circunstanciado (art. 157 § 2º, 1/3 to 1/2) needs concrete reasons. The number of majorantes present is not enough to raise the fraction.

provenance.source: STJ, Súmula 443 (scon)
provenance.citation: STJ Súmula 443, TERCEIRA SEÇÃO, julgado em 28/04/2010, DJe 13/05/2010
provenance.quote: O aumento na terceira fase de aplicação da pena no crime de roubo circunstanciado exige fundamentação concreta, não sendo suficiente para a sua exasperação a mera indicação do número de majorantes.

entries.disposition_note: The brief already requires ranges to be encoded as ranges with the choice left to the judge. The súmula confirms that no mapping from 'number of majorantes' to a fraction may be computed, so its substance is inside that rule.

entries.summary: STJ Súmula 567: electronic surveillance or security staff inside a shop does not, by itself, make furto an impossible crime (art. 17).

provenance.source: STJ, Súmula 567 (scon)
provenance.citation: STJ Súmula 567, TERCEIRA SEÇÃO, julgado em 24/02/2016, DJe 29/02/2016
provenance.quote: Sistema de vigilância realizado por monitoramento eletrônico ou por existência de segurança no interior de estabelecimento comercial, por si só, não torna impossível a configuração do crime de furto.

entries.disposition_note: Art. 155's elements do not mention surveillance, and crime impossível is art. 17 (sweep-a's range). An encoding that takes 'meio absolutamente ineficaz' as an input absorbs this: surveillance alone must not set that input.

entries.summary: STJ Súmula 17: when a forgery is used up in the estelionato (art. 171) and has no further harmful potential, the estelionato absorbs it.

provenance.source: STJ, Súmula 17 (scon)
provenance.citation: STJ Súmula 17, TERCEIRA SEÇÃO, julgado em 20/11/1990, DJ 28/11/1990, p. 13963
provenance.quote: Quando o falso se exaure no estelionato, sem mais potencialidade lesiva, é por este absorvido.

entries.disposition_note: Absorption between offences is a question of concurso, outside the per-offence contract. Nothing in art. 171's predicate or pena changes. Recorded for any later concurso layer.

entries.summary: STJ Súmula 24: the art. 171 § 3º increase for a victim that is an 'entidade de direito público' applies when the victim is the social-security autarchy (INSS).

provenance.source: STJ, Súmula 24 (scon)
provenance.citation: STJ Súmula 24, TERCEIRA SEÇÃO, julgado em 04/04/1991, DJ 10/04/1991, p. 4043
provenance.quote: Aplica-se ao crime de estelionato, em que figure como vítima entidade autárquica da previdência social, a qualificadora do § 3º, do art. 171 do Código Penal.

entries.disposition_note: The encoder takes 'a vítima é entidade de direito público' as an input. The súmula confirms that an autarquia previdenciária satisfies it, so no fork is needed.

entries.summary: STJ Súmula 73: using grossly counterfeit paper money is, in principle, estelionato (art. 171) and not moeda falsa (art. 289, sweep-c's range), and belongs to state courts.

provenance.source: STJ, Súmula 73 (scon)
provenance.citation: STJ Súmula 73, TERCEIRA SEÇÃO, julgado em 15/04/1993, DJ 20/04/1993, p. 6769
provenance.quote: A utilização de papel moeda grosseiramente falsificado configura, em tese, o crime de estelionato, da competência da Justiça Estadual.

entries.disposition_note: It draws the boundary with art. 289 (sweep-c) and a competence rule. Art. 171's elements already take 'meio fraudulento' as input, so nothing changes in this range.

entries.summary: STJ Súmula 502: offering pirated CDs and DVDs for sale is typical conduct under art. 184 § 2º when materiality and authorship are proved. This rejects the social-adequacy defence.

provenance.source: STJ, Súmula 502 (scon)
provenance.citation: STJ Súmula 502, TERCEIRA SEÇÃO, julgado em 23/10/2013, DJe 28/10/2013
provenance.quote: Presentes a materialidade e a autoria, afigura-se típica, em relação ao crime previsto no art. 184, § 2º, do CP, a conduta de expor à venda CDs e DVDs piratas.

entries.disposition_note: The text of § 2º already reads this way ('expõe à venda … cópia … reproduzido com violação'). The súmula closes off a judge-made escape rather than changing the text.

entries.summary: STJ Súmula 574 (art. 184): a sample-based expert inspection of the external features of the seized goods is enough to prove materiality, and the rights-holders need not be identified.

provenance.source: STJ, Súmula 574 (scon)
provenance.citation: STJ Súmula 574, TERCEIRA SEÇÃO, julgado em 22/06/2016, DJe 27/06/2016
provenance.quote: Para a configuração do delito de violação de direito autoral e a comprovação de sua materialidade, é suficiente a perícia realizada por amostragem do produto apreendido, nos aspectos externos do material, e é desnecessária a identificação dos titulares dos direitos autorais violados ou daqueles que os representem.

entries.disposition_note: It is a rule of proof, and the encoding takes proved facts as inputs.

entries.summary: STJ Súmula 174 (a toy gun authorised the roubo increase) was CANCELLED by the 3ª Seção on 24/10/2002 (REsp 213.054/SP). Today art. 157 § 2º-A I requires 'arma de fogo' and § 2º VII 'arma branca'.

provenance.source: STJ, Súmula 174 (scon), with its cancellation note
provenance.citation: STJ Súmula 174 (TERCEIRA SEÇÃO, julgado em 23/10/1996, DJ 31/10/1996), cancelada (DJ 11/11/2002, p. 148)
provenance.quote: A Terceira Seção, na sessão de 24/10/2002, ao julgar o REsp 213.054/SP, determinou o CANCELAMENTO da Súmula 174 do STJ (DJ 11/11/2002, p. 148).

entries.disposition_note: Cancelled, so it has no effect. Recorded in one line so that no encoder revives it.

entries.summary: Competence súmulas on offences in this range: STF 603 (latrocínio is tried by a single judge, not the Júri), STJ 48 and 244 (estelionato by cheque: place where the advantage was obtained / place of refusal) and STJ 107 (estelionato with forged social-security payment slips: state courts when no federal autarchy is harmed). STF 603 also confirms that latrocínio is a property crime, not a crime against life.

provenance.source: LexML Brasil, Súmula nº 603 do STF (urn:lex:br:supremo.tribunal.federal:sumula:1984-10-17;603); STJ scon, Súmulas 48, 107, 244
provenance.citation: STF Súmula 603 (17/10/1984); STJ Súmula 48 ('Compete ao juízo do local da obtenção da vantagem ilícita processar e julgar crime de estelionato cometido mediante falsificação de cheque.'); STJ Súmula 107; STJ Súmula 244 ('Compete ao foro do local da recusa processar e julgar o crime de estelionato mediante cheque sem provisão de fundos.')
provenance.quote: A COMPETÊNCIA PARA O PROCESSO E JULGAMENTO DE LATROCÍNIO É DO JUIZ SINGULAR E NÃO DO TRIBUNAL DO JÚRI.

entries.disposition_note: Procedural competence is outside the encoding. Whether STJ 48/244 survive Lei 14.155/2021's change to the CPP was not checked.

entries.summary: STJ repetitive Tema 1110 concerns the window between Lei 13.654/2018 (which revoked art. 157 § 2º I, 'arma') and Lei 13.964/2019 (which inserted § 2º VII, 'arma branca'). In that window a knife was not a majorante and could weigh only at the first sentencing phase. The TJDFT page also records that the STF upheld the validity of Lei 13.654/2018.

provenance.source: TJDFT, Precedentes qualificados › Direito penal › Roubo › Tema 1110 (pesquisa realizada em 22/1/2024)
provenance.citation: STJ, Tema repetitivo 1.110
provenance.quote: 1. Em razão da novatio legis in mellius engendrada pela Lei n. 13.654/2018, o emprego de arma branca, embora não configure mais causa de aumento do crime de roubo, poderá ser utilizado como fundamento para a majoração da pena-base, quando as circunstâncias do caso concreto assim justificarem.

entries.disposition_note: It governs only facts between 2018-04-24 and the entry into force of Lei 13.964/2019. The compiled § 2º VII (arma branca) is the current law. Relevant only if the encoding models that window on the rule-version axis.

entries.summary: Three STJ Maria da Penha súmulas operate on crimes in this range when committed against a woman in the domestic setting (arts. 129 § 9º and § 13, 147, 147-A, 147-B and others): Súmula 589 (insignificance does not apply), 588 (no substitution by restritivas de direitos) and 536 (no suspensão condicional do processo or transação penal). They act on Parte Geral and procedural institutions, not on elements or cominações.

provenance.source: STJ, Súmulas 536, 588, 589 (scon)
provenance.citation: STJ Súmula 589 (TERCEIRA SEÇÃO, julgado em 13/09/2017, DJe 18/09/2017); Súmula 588 ('A prática de crime ou contravenção penal contra a mulher com violência ou grave ameaça no ambiente doméstico impossibilita a substituição da pena privativa de liberdade por restritiva de direitos.'); Súmula 536 ('A suspensão condicional do processo e a transação penal não se aplicam na hipótese de delitos sujeitos ao rito da Lei Maria da Penha.')
provenance.quote: É inaplicável o princípio da insignificância nos crimes ou contravenções penais praticados contra a mulher no âmbito das relações domésticas.

entries.disposition_note: No predicate or pena in arts. 121–212 changes. Súmula 589 constrains F-sweep-b-21 (insignificância), and 588 and 536 belong with sweep-a's arts. 44 and 77 and with procedure.

entries.summary: Lei 15.358/2026 inserted arts. 121 § 2º-D, 129 §§ 3º-A and 8º-A, 147-C, 148 § 3º, 155 § 9º, 157 §§ 4º–5º, 159 § 5º and 180 § 8º. Each cites 'art. 2º da lei que institui o marco legal do combate ao crime organizado no Brasil' by description. That law is Lei 15.358/2026 itself (Lei Raul Jungmann). Its art. 2º lists the conducts (incisos I–X) and art. 2º § 2º defines 'organização criminosa ultraviolenta'. Art. 158 § 4º is worded differently in Lei 15.358's own text, so this is not a compilation slip. It says 'organização criminosa' without 'ultraviolenta' and 'condutas previstas' without naming any law or article.

provenance.source: Planalto, Lei nº 15.358, de 24 de março de 2026, arts. 1º, 2º and 33 (the CP amendments)
provenance.citation: Lei nº 15.358/2026, art. 2º § 2º; art. 158 § 4º as inserted ('Se os crimes previstos neste artigo são cometidos por integrante de organização criminosa, grupo paramilitar ou milícia privada, no contexto da atuação ou para a consecução das condutas previstas, aplica-se em triplo a respectiva pena.')
provenance.quote: § 2º Para os fins desta Lei, considera-se organização criminosa ultraviolenta, denominada facção criminosa, o agrupamento de 3 (três) ou mais pessoas que emprega violência, grave ameaça ou coação para impor controle territorial ou social, intimidar populações ou autoridades ou atacar serviços, infraestrutura ou equipamentos essenciais ou que pratica atos destinados à execução dos crimes tipificados nesta Lei.

entries.disposition_note: The encoders take membership, context and purpose as input facts. They should cite Lei 15.358 art. 2º as the law described, and should not encode that law. The encoder of art. 158 creates F-sweep-b-22 on § 4º's wording.

entries.summary: ADPF 338: on 5 February 2026 the STF Plenário held, by majority, that art. 141 II (a third more for crimes against the honour of a public servant because of the servant's functions) is compatible with the Constitution. The rapporteur, Min. Barroso, proposed limiting it to calúnia and did not carry the majority, and Min. Fachin voted for non-reception. So the text stands as written for calúnia, difamação and injúria alike.

entries.summary: STF Tema 1053 (RE 1.167.478, Plenário, 8.11.2023; repercussão geral) holds that after EC 66/2010 judicial separation is neither a requirement for divorce nor an autonomous institution. The civil status of people already separated by judicial decision or public deed is preserved as an ato jurídico perfeito. For art. 182 I ('do cônjuge desquitado ou judicialmente separado') this means the class is closed. It covers the desquitados and those judicially separated before the thesis, and possibly those separated by public deed, who the thesis also preserves. Nobody can newly enter it. Couples who split from now on are either still married, and then art. 181 I governs, or divorced, which neither art. 181 nor art. 182 names.

Sem prejuízo, preserva-se o estado civil das pessoas que já estão separadas por decisão judicial ou escritura pública, por se tratar de um ato jurídico perfeito

entries.summary: Art. 201 and the right to strike (fork F-g3b-10). No STF or STJ decision on whether art. 201 was received by CF art. 9º was reached. What was found: the 5ª Turma Recursal of the Justiça Federal do Rio Grande do Sul (2014), reported by Conjur, convicted a union president under art. 201 on appeal from an acquittal, rejecting the defence that art. 201 was not received by the 1988 Constitution and holding the article in force, on the footing that Lei 7.783/1989 art. 15 makes those who commit unlawful acts or crimes in the course of a strike answerable under the penal law. The decision is a Juizado Especial Federal appellate body's, binds no one else, and is known here only through a press report, not the acórdão. The report also says the judge noted that the question is not settled in penal doctrine. So the reading 'comoEscrito' of F-g3b-10 has one lower-court decision behind it and the reading 'naoRecepcionado' none; nothing is settled.

entries.summary: Arts. 165–166 of the Code against Lei 9.605/1998 arts. 62–63 (fork F-g3-18). The two laws cover overlapping ground with different wording and heavier penalties in the later one: art. 165 ('coisa tombada pela autoridade competente em virtude de valor artístico, arqueológico ou histórico': detenção de seis meses a dois anos, e multa) against art. 62 ('bem especialmente protegido por lei, ato administrativo ou decisão judicial', and archives, museums and the like: reclusão de um a três anos, e multa, with a culposo form); art. 166 ('local especialmente protegido por lei', altered 'sem licença': detenção de um mês a um ano, ou multa) against art. 63 (edificação or local protected by law, administrative act or judicial decision, altered for reasons of value, without or against authorisation: reclusão de um a três anos, e multa). Lei 9.605 has no clause revoking either article of the Code: its art. 82 is the general 'Revogam-se as disposições em contrário'. So any revocation would be tacit (LINDB art. 2º, § 1º), and no decision on it was reached. Arts. 62–63 are the broader and later provisions. A tombamento is an administrative act, so a thing 'tombada' is within art. 62's 'bem especialmente protegido por … ato administrativo'. The evidence points toward displacement of the Code's articles as to what the later law covers, but it is a reading of two texts, not authority.

provenance.source: Planalto, Lei nº 9.605, de 12 de fevereiro de 1998 (l9605.htm), arts. 62, 63, 82; the Code's arts. 165, 166 from SOURCE/codigo-penal-1940.txt lines 1241–1245
provenance.citation: Lei nº 9.605/1998, arts. 62 and 63 (quoted); art. 82 ('Revogam-se as disposições em contrário.'); CP arts. 165 and 166
provenance.quote: Art. 62. Destruir, inutilizar ou deteriorar: I - bem especialmente protegido por lei, ato administrativo ou decisão judicial; II - arquivo, registro, museu, biblioteca, pinacoteca, instalação científica ou similar protegido por lei, ato administrativo ou decisão judicial: Pena - reclusão, de um a três anos, e multa. Parágrafo único. Se o crime for culposo, a pena é de seis meses a um ano de detenção, sem prejuízo da multa. Art. 63. Alterar o aspecto ou estrutura de edificação ou local especialmente protegido por lei, ato administrativo ou decisão judicial, em razão de seu valor paisagístico, ecológico, turístico, artístico, histórico, cultural, religioso, arqueológico, etnográfico ou monumental, sem autorização da autoridade competente ou em desacordo com a concedida: Pena - reclusão, de um a três anos, e multa.

entries.disposition_note: Bears on F-g3-18 (encoder g3, arts. 155–183-A). entries.summary: Lei nº 9.609/1998 (software law), art. 12: 'Violar direitos de autor de programa de computador' is its own crime, with detenção de seis meses a dois anos ou multa, and a reclusão de um a quatro anos e multa form for reproduction for trade (§ 1º). The law was published in the DOU on 20.2.1998 (rectified 25.2.1998). It is the special law for the author's rights in a program, and CP art. 12 leaves a special law's own rules in place. This is the statute F-g3b-02 applies to take computer programs out of art. 184; the sweep had no entry for it.

V24 (art. 148) and V27 (art. 159) point to Lei 10.446/2002 art. 1º I (Planalto anchor L10446.htm#art1i). It lets the Polícia Federal investigate 'seqüestro, cárcere privado e extorsão mediante seqüestro (arts. 148 e 159 do Código Penal), se o agente foi impelido por motivação política ou quando praticado em razão da função pública exercida pela vítima'. V29 (art. 181) and V30 (art. 182) point to Lei 10.741/2003 art. 95, which denies the immunities for crimes defined in the Estatuto da Pessoa Idosa. Those crimes lie outside the Code. For the Code's own Título II the same Lei's art. 183 III is already compiled text.

V34–V38 are the five bare 'Vide Lei nº 8.072, de 25.7.90' pointers at art. 158 § 2º (line 1190) and art. 159 caput, § 1º, § 2º and § 3º (lines 1195, 1197, 1199, 1201). Planalto links them to Lei 8.072/1990 art. 9º: plus half when the victim is in an art. 224 situation. Art. 224 was revoked by Lei 12.015/2009, so whether art. 9º still operates is fork F-sweep-b-02, which the encoder of arts. 157–159 creates. Lei 8.072 art. 6º also gave arts. 159 caput and §§ 1º–3º their current penalties, which the compiled text already applies. Its art. 1º (heinous-crime status) affects sentence execution, not the per-offence contract.
